patterns.note: Asymmetric two-column grid where the left column is reserved for small section labels, structural anchors, or large imagery, while the right column contains the primary editorial content.
High-contrast dark mode palette utilizing pure black backgrounds, crisp white typography, and a singular vibrant magenta accent color reserved exclusively for interactive links and primary CTAs.
Editorial typographic hierarchy featuring clean, high-contrast sans-serif type with selective bolding of key phrases within body copy and testimonials to facilitate scanning.
Smooth momentum scrolling paired with subtle scroll-triggered reveals and sticky positioning of left-column labels that remain anchored as right-column content scrolls past.

technique_notes: Recreate the smooth scrolling experience using Locomotive Scroll to implement momentum-based scrolling. Use CSS sticky positioning on the left-column labels so they remain fixed in place while the longer right-column content scrolls vertically. Implement subtle fade-in animations for text blocks as they enter the viewport using CSS keyframes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Highly structured sans-serif scale with large, clean headings (~4x body size) and standard body text utilizing bold weights for emphasis.

standout: The site's standout feature is its uncompromising, ultra-minimalist asymmetric layout that leaves the entire left half of the screen as negative space or dedicated to single-word anchors, creating an incredibly premium, editorial feel that mimics high-end print design.
